name: Rioja (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, orange and blue with an orange middle stripe of double width, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Rioja (palm trees and a bridge over waves).
history: Rioja was authorised by the Junta de Andalucía on 13 December 1999 to adopt its symbols but did not do so until April 2007; the flag is of proportions 1:1.5 formed of three horizontal stripes, blue, orange and blue, the orange twice the width of the blue ones, charged at the centre with the municipal arms.

features.role: Rioja arms — palm trees and bridge over waves
